name: Soulseek
author: Viboplr
description: Search and download from the Soulseek network via a slskd daemon: ranked results, whole-album grabs, live transfer progress, finished files that play and reach your library, and a playback fallback that fetches a missing track from Soulseek.

permissionReasons.network:*: Talk to the slskd server at the address you set, which can be on any host, and find one running on this computer
permissionReasons.exec:roadie: Ask Roadie to install or start slskd, each step after you approve it, and read the address and key it reports
permissionReasons.files:read: Read title, artist and album from finished downloads instead of guessing from the file name
permissionReasons.system:open: Open slskd's web page, the setup guides, and the folders where Roadie keeps slskd's settings
permissionReasons.library:read: Check your copy's quality before an upgrade, an album's missing tracks, and whether downloads land in a collection
permissionReasons.library:write: Rescan a collection when a download lands in it, and swap in a better copy once you approve it
permissionReasons.playback:control: Play finished Soulseek downloads from the Downloads tab

viewHeader.subtitle: Search and download from the Soulseek network

binaryDependencies.name: roadie
binaryDependencies.reason: Optional: installs and runs slskd for you, each step after you approve it

assistant.instructions: Fetch music from the Soulseek peer-to-peer network through the user's slskd daemon. Flow: status (connected? signed in? where do downloads land?) → search (a real network search, ~5-30s; results are ranked best-first and carry an id) → download with one or more result ids. A download sits in another user's upload queue — it can take minutes or hours — so watch it with list_downloads rather than waiting. download is a real transfer the user's daemon performs: only download what the user actually asked for. Finished files play from the Downloads tab, and land in the library automatically when slskd's downloads folder is inside a collection. Upgrading a library track to a better copy, two ways: (a) interactive — search with upgradeFor=<library track id> (only files that beat the copy in hand), let the user pick, download, watch list_downloads until the row has a uri; (b) automatic — upgrade with the track id (this plugin searches, downloads and checks the file itself), watch list_upgrades until state is ready. Either way the finished file's uri goes to Viboplr's replace_track_file, which stages it and shows current vs new; replace only after the user says yes.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Connection state (unconfigured / unreachable / unauthorized / disconnected / connecting / ready), the Soulseek username, slskd version, whether slskd shares anything, and where finished downloads land

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Soulseek network. Slow (5-30s, one search at a time). Returns ranked candidates: id, user, filename, folder, quality (format, bitrate, lossless), size, duration, and availability (free slot / queue length / upload speed). With upgradeFor each result also says where it came from — the album's own folder, another folder, or a compilation or vinyl rip (listed in that order) — and notAnUpgrade names a different recording or a multichannel mix. Feed ids to download

query.description: Free text — artist, album and/or track. Soulseek matches on file and folder names

durationSecs.description: Expected track length; candidates more than 5s off are dropped (catches mislabeled files)

upgradeFor.description: Library track id of a LOCAL file to upgrade: query and duration default to that track, and only results that beat its quality are returned. A download from this search is stamped as that track's upgrade

showAll.description: With upgradeFor: return every result, each flagged better true/false

tools.name: download
tools.description: Queue one or more search results (by id, from any of the last 5 search calls) in slskd. A real download the user's daemon performs — download only what the user asked for. Returns the queued files; progress via list_downloads

ids.description: Result ids from search. Pass every file of a folder to grab a whole album

tools.name: list_downloads
tools.description: The downloads slskd is managing, newest first (50 unless limit says otherwise): file, user, phase (requested / queued / starting / downloading / succeeded / failed / cancelled), progress (0-1), place in the other user's queue, speed, error, upgradeFor (the library track it was fetched to upgrade), and — once finished and slskd runs on this computer — the local path and a uri for Viboplr's replace_track_file / download_plugin_track. Filter to find one file instead of reading them all

upgradeFor.description: Only downloads fetched to upgrade this library track id

query.description: Only files whose name, title, artist or album contains this (accents and case ignored)

tools.name: upgrade
tools.description: The automatic Upgrade (the Upgrades tab): action=start looks for a better copy of a LOCAL library track in the background — search, pick, download from a sharer, then check the real bitrate — at the user's Upgrade target setting. Also retry, take_alternative (accept the best better copy that missed the target), cancel (stop a search or download in progress) and remove. Never replaces anything itself

tools.name: list_upgrades
tools.description: The automatic upgrades: state (searching / downloading / checking / ready / alternative / none / failed / cancelled / replaced / gone), message, the library copy's quality, live download progress, and — when ready — the checked file's quality and the uri for Viboplr's replace_track_file. Replaced entries are left out unless includeReplaced is set; a file downloaded by hand for an upgrade (search with upgradeFor) takes over its track's entry once it lands
